description: Adaptation policy for Vannevar Code — defines allowed final statuses, review requirements, and operational constraints per engineering standard v3.

levelDefinitions.A: Fully automated, no human, no real bundle
levelDefinitions.B: Fixture-based, explicit pristine path, no real install
levelDefinitions.D: Production release, push, install — manual approval only

commitPushReleaseSeparation.commit: Adapted source + updated verifiedAgainst + evidence hashes
commitPushReleaseSeparation.push: Only after CI green (registry validation, adaptation tests, full npm test)
commitPushReleaseSeparation.release: Manual approval only, never auto-release on push

edgeCases.noCanaryChannel: Skip canary-specific probes, direct to stable channel analysis
edgeCases.nativeBinaryChanged: Trigger ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW, cannot proceed without explicit sign-off

restorePolicyRequirements.registryGoverned: Requires target marker, registered policy, exact boundaries, preconditions, postcondition 'markers removed + syntax valid'
restorePolicyRequirements.idempotent: Second run on restored bundle = no-op success

artifactPolicy.pristineBundleHandling: explicit path at adaptation time, remains outside Git
